question: Which bodily regions are assigned protection in this portion of the nyāsa?
premises: The cheeks are named as a locus
The head within is named as a locus
inference: The mantra is invoked to protect the cheeks and the head within always
uncertainties: Exact parsing and function of aiśvaryāṇy antantu in this line
plain_english: May it always protect my cheeks, and may the powers protect within my head.
